fns.desc: http_post() leaks the CURL easy handle returned by setup_curl_post()/curl_easy_init() on every call (success and all `goto fail` paths) -- unlike http_download_file(), there is no curl_easy_cleanup(curl) anywhere in the function.

Same function also leaks the `struct curl_slist *curl_hdr` list built via curl_slist_append() (content_type/ext_hdr headers) -- curl_slist_free_all(curl_hdr) is never called on any path; clear_curl()/free_curl_buf() only touch ctx->curl/ctx->curl_hdr, not this function-local curl/curl_hdr pair.
